rationale: CNB interpretive-opinions section is a recurring publisher defining the CZ payments authorisation perimeter.
SumUp CZ mPOS pages are a core competitor signal but URL verification failed; recheck liveness.
Dotykacka/Dotypay is a live CZ POS+payments distributor competing with bank acquiring.
Payten/Sonet POS spec pages map supported terminal hardware and acquirer protocols in CZ.
ERP/ECR integration docs indirectly enumerate the CZ terminal estate and acquirer certifications.
APEK member directory is a one-time lead mine; access unknown and URL check failed.
Lupa.cz payments tag feed is a continuously producing CZ trade-press signal stream.
Protext wire aggregates full-text CZ payments press releases in one monitorable archive.
Second-tier CZ gateway useful for pricing benchmarks and long-tail competitor mapping.
Shopify app search is a one-pass cross-check of which CZ PSPs publish platform apps.
CERTIS hub is the root portal for CZK clearing infrastructure and participant enumeration.
Versioned instant-payment participant PDF gives dateable diffs of bank go-lives; monitor the file.
CERTIS rulebook plus annexes are versioned upstream triggers for bank IT change programmes.
COBS open-banking standard section publishes successive rulebook versions vendors must build to.
CBA association hub carries news, commissions and position papers pre-announcing standard changes.
Bank iD operator site is a live scheme source plus relying-party/integrator directory.
KB press room is a recurring feed dating infrastructure milestones and naming suppliers.
KB developer portal gives a direct technical read on bank API versioning and COBS conformance.
State eID hub publishes qualified identity and service provider registries; updated continuously.
mojeID is the non-bank eID competitor to Bank iD with ongoing integration documentation.
NAP NIA page is a section of the gov.cz architecture repository already covered by the parent domain.
EPC scheme adherence register is a maintained, filterable roster of CZ PSPs per SEPA scheme.
EBA CLEARING participant lists show which CZ-market banks reach euro instant rails directly.
ECB digital euro pages publish rulebook versions and supplier selections shaping future CZ vendor demand.
CNB instant-payments pages carry the 2027/2028 euro instant deadlines driving CZ infrastructure spend.
Mesec.cz maintains a comparative bank-by-bank instant-payment table plus rollout news; useful cross-check.
Bank iD tag hub is a sibling tag on lupa.cz already captured by monitoring that domain's tag feeds.
Conference-deck archive yields occasional roadmap detail but value and reuse rights are unclear.
